rule: These are monitored concepts, not equivalent keyword buckets. Multiple sector tags are allowed; store separate asset_class, strategy and instrument fields. Sector presence never proves a holding.

sectors.inclusion_logic: Require financing, debt-service, valuation or exit consequences for software exposure; technology news alone is insufficient.
sectors.exclusion_logic: Product releases, app reviews, coding tutorials and broad AI excitement.
sectors.ambiguity_risks: ARR is not cash flow; revenue growth is not automatically credit improvement.
sectors.investment_relevance: Software is an industry exposure across private credit, PE and VC; no specific borrower holding inferred.

sectors.inclusion_logic: Material credit terms, portfolio quality, supply/demand or manager franchise change; identify instrument and borrower/manager role.
sectors.exclusion_logic: Routine loan marketing, consumer borrowing advice, undifferentiated private-company stories.
sectors.ambiguity_risks: Private credit is broader than direct lending; private does not always describe the loan market; PIK can be contractual rather than stress.
sectors.investment_relevance: Core monitoring strategy; default/recovery, net return and deployment conditions.

sectors.inclusion_logic: Identify an ownership/financing claim on the manager or management-company cash flows and material economics.
sectors.exclusion_logic: Routine GP-led secondary or LP stake sale labelled GP stakes solely due to wording.
sectors.ambiguity_risks: GP-led secondaries buy fund assets/interests, not necessarily manager equity; sports minority stakes are not GP stakes.
sectors.investment_relevance: Manager franchise value, fee streams, governance and fundraising; Blue Owl GP platform is a monitoring link.

sectors.inclusion_logic: Material lease economics, fleet/lessee credit, collateral value or financing supply; airline event needs lessor/asset effect.
sectors.exclusion_logic: Route announcements, passenger travel advice and routine aircraft photos.
sectors.ambiguity_risks: An aircraft order is not a lease; OEM issues require delivery/collateral or cash-flow transmission.
sectors.investment_relevance: Asset-backed cash flows, recovery values and financing conditions; exact lessor holdings unknown.

sectors.inclusion_logic: Identify collateral, seniority, loss absorption, financing terms or platform economics; material change needed.
sectors.exclusion_logic: Generic corporate asset sale, cryptocurrency promotion and unrelated ABL/ABS abbreviations.
sectors.ambiguity_risks: Working-capital ABL is a subset, not all ABF; ABS is a security structure; anti-lock braking is not ABS credit.
sectors.investment_relevance: Collateral performance, underwriting, funding and securitisation exits; relevant to BasePoint and broad credit platforms.

sectors.inclusion_logic: Material valuation, rental income, refinancing, fund liquidity or institutional capital flows; allow debt and equity transmission.
sectors.exclusion_logic: Individual home listings, interior design and routine local sales without portfolio/market consequence.
sectors.ambiguity_risks: Residential vs commercial, debt vs equity and local vs systemic must stay distinct; REIT price alone is not private NAV.
sectors.investment_relevance: Property cash flow, valuation and debt coverage across real-estate/private-credit exposures.

sectors.inclusion_logic: New collateral/servicing/funding evidence with investment consequences; use Pretium/Bayview links only when resolved.
sectors.exclusion_logic: Retail mortgage-rate tips, household refinancing advice and routine broker advertising.
sectors.ambiguity_risks: Agency/non-agency and residential/commercial are distinct; lower rates can help borrowers yet hurt MSR values or increase prepayment.
sectors.investment_relevance: Credit losses, prepayment, servicing costs and securitisation economics.

sectors.inclusion_logic: Material issuance/terms, collateral quality, tranche risk, financing economics or manager capacity; identify transaction stage.
sectors.exclusion_logic: Routine tiny spread move without context, generic career news or repeated deal marketing.
sectors.ambiguity_risks: Chief legal officer is not CLO; liability spread widening differs from asset yield widening; reset differs from refinancing.
sectors.investment_relevance: Collateral loss/default risk, financing cost, reinvestment and equity distributions; CIFC/structured-credit platforms are relevant.
